name: @forge/eval-loop-demo
description: Demo video project: 'How do you test a conversation?' — consumes the tools/SizzleCraft engine.
_dependencyNote: These two belong to the CONSUMING project, not the engine — tools/SizzleCraft/README.md says so explicitly. gsap is inlined into video-auto.html by write-build-html.mjs (from <project>/node_modules/gsap/dist/gsap.min.js); mp4-muxer is loaded by encode-mp4.mjs from <project>/node_modules/mp4-muxer/build/mp4-muxer.js. Both paths are resolved against the project dir, so installing them in the engine does not work.
